notHosted.title: This game is not hosted
notHosted.body: Finish the wizard to start the server, locally or on archipelago.gg.

resumed.title: Game resumed from its save: the save’s options win
resumed.body: Rules changed since the first start do not apply: the server keeps the ones stored in the save.

stopped.title: The server is stopped
stopped.body: The progress is saved. Start the game again from the wizard whenever you like.
stopped.forced: The server stopped answering: it was stopped by force and the last minute of play may have been lost.

stop.title: Stop the server?
stop.body: The server saves the game and then stops: connected players will be disconnected.
stop.later: You can resume it later, right where you left off.
stop.force: If it does not answer within 15 s, it is stopped by force: the last minute of play may then be lost.

connection.title: Connection
connection.starting: The server is starting, the addresses are on their way…
connection.publicHint: To play over the Internet, forward port {{port}} (TCP) to this PC on your router.
connection.asleep: The room is asleep: wake it up to get its port.
connection.timeout: Goes to sleep after {{duration}} without activity
connection.roomError: The room state is not available: {{error}}
connection.asleepPort: The room is asleep: wake it up before playing, its port may change.

share.title: Message to share
share.hint: Paste it in your group chat so everyone knows where to connect.
share.heading: Archipelago game: {{name}}

players.title: Players
players.webHint: archipelago.gg does not say who is connected: the room log does.

feed.title: Item feed
feed.allGoals: The whole team finished their games. Well done!

console.title: Server console
console.offline: The console comes alive once the server is ready.
console.logError: The room log is not available: {{error}}. Trying again in 5 s.

commands.release: Send out a player’s remaining items
commands.collect: Give a player all of their remaining items

release.title: Release a player’s items
release.body: Sends every remaining item of this player’s world to its owners. This cannot be undone.

collect.title: Collect a player’s items
collect.body: Gives this player all of their remaining items, wherever they are. This cannot be undone.

files.title: Player files
files.hint: Send each player the file of their slot: they open it to start their game.
files.copyLinkFor: Copy the download link for slot {{name}}
files.noFile: No file: this game connects to the server directly.
files.none: No files yet: the game has not been generated.
